texts.text: Turn your financial plans into achievable milestones.
Every contribution brings you closer to your goals.
Savings are allocations of existing funds, not extra assets. Contributions never count as new income unless explicitly classified as income.
Illustrative BDT records · Goals reference wallet funds without duplicating your assets.
Give your next milestone a plan.
Starts at zero · Allocate funds after creation.
A plan, not an automatic transfer.
A goal is an allocation plan, not a new wallet or extra asset. Starting savings must be backed by a recorded contribution.
A safety net for unexpected expenses and peace of mind.
Created 01 Sep 2026 · Goal savings are allocations, not additional assets.
Record one contribution with a clear funding source.

Wallet balance stays ৳35,000. Total assets do not increase. Save once with one linked allocation record; no new income or expense.
The allocation and its funding link are saved together. If saving fails, nothing changes. Retry with the same request key.

Goals earmark funds; they are not wallets or additional assets. Internal allocation reduces unallocated funds, not the wallet balance. External deposits create one linked wallet record and allocation, never duplicate income.
Four targets total ৳200,000; saved ৳72,000; remaining ৳128,000; completion 36%. No base goal is near completion, so the summary says 4 goals in progress.
Paused and completed goals are excluded from active totals. Deleting a goal releases allocations, preserves wallet balances and transaction history. Existing contributions are read-only in Edit Goal.

Fixed-sample create, edit, contribution, details, filters and status changes are represented. Code must provide real inputs, persistence, idempotent atomic writes, live wallet availability, history and global privacy state.
Deliverable is desktop only. In React/Tailwind: use a 2-column goal grid, stack at smaller breakpoints, preserve field order, and use max-height scrollable modals with accessible keyboard focus.
